description: This file defines a Moose role for a Catalyst plugin that sets the HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header in web responses. It hooks into the 'prepare_action' phase to conditionally add the header based on configuration and request scheme.

classes.name: Coocook::Plugin::StrictTransportSecurity
classes.description: A Moose role for a Catalyst plugin that manages the HTTP Strict Transport Security header.

methods.name: prepare_action
methods.description: A hook that runs after the 'prepare_action' phase in Catalyst, responsible for setting the HSTS header if conditions are met.
